risk_note: RV1 (agent module only). Follow-up of B1-10q (D10-1341 ②, #3256 review): ① the admin session detail orders messages by created_at, then user before assistant at the same instant, then id (online a turn's user and assistant rows share one created_at and their UUIDv7 ids differ only in random bits, so the old created_at -> id order put the answer first about half the time); ② on the admin read only, a claim_draft card's data.order_no goes through maskForTrace (BR-AI-14: keep the last 4 digits, the same masking as the trace's tool arguments); other cards, other fields, the stored row and the user side are unchanged; ③ a failed audit write still answers 50001 with no session content (B1-10q behaviour, now pinned by a rule test); ④ the frozen [AC-B1-10q#15] tightened (modify_existing tighten_only, ruling D10-1341): its tool-call created_at values are shuffled so neither ascending nor descending created_at yields the expected order; expectation, assertions and title unchanged. Host: integration spec/agent/admin-traces-followup + spec/agent/admin-traces 16/16, apps/api agent unit + contract.test 480, foreign-db-handoff 19, eslint / prettier / tsc / depcruise 0.

Container red/1 ok, problems 0, 2 red; [AC-B1-10q#15] passes green as declared modify_existing.
